Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a bonus when the leftover lies between one and two item sizes, so bins that stay usable for one or two more identical items outrank slightly tighter ones. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when the tightest leftover is outside that band. It may help by banking reusable bins, or fail when identical sizes rarely repeat.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (60 if r - item >= item and r - item <= 2 * item else 0)) for r in bins]
```
